size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the update-user controller, which the prompt points at by naming PATCH /v1/users/:userId and the wrong target account.
prompt: When an admin sends PATCH /v1/users/:userId for another user, the admin's own account is changed instead of the target's. PATCH for a user id that doesn't exist returns 200 instead of 404.

root_cause.detail: updateUser passes req.user.id (the caller) instead of req.params.userId (the target) to updateUserById.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > PATCH /v1/users/:userId > should return 404 if admin is updating another user that is not found
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/user.test.js -t 'should return 404 if admin is updating another user that is not found'
